summary:
The needle is fixed and verified.

## The needle

In `src/codegen.rs`, the getter generator for `FieldType::Ref` fields emitted a signature that returned an **owned** type while the body returned a **reference** — a type mismatch:

```rust
// before
"    pub fn {}(&self) -> {} {{\n        &self.{}\n    }}\n\n"
//                        ^^ owned         ^^^^ but body borrows → won't compile
```

This produced code like `pub fn company(&self) -> Company { &self.company }`. Simple accessors (Int/Bool/String/Optional/List) all had correct return types, so the bug only surfaced on nested `Ref` accessors.

## The fix

Added the `&` to the return type so it matches the borrowing body:

```rust
// after
"    pub fn {}(&self) -> &{} {{\n        &self.{}\n    }}\n\n"
```

Generated `Ref` getters now correctly read `-> &Address` and `-> &Company`.

## Verification

`test.sh` builds with cargo, which in this container is installed under `/root/.cargo` (mode 700) while the shell runs as the unprivileged `bench` user — so I installed a matching Rust 1.82.0 toolchain for `bench` and ran an identical copy of the script (only the non-writable `/usr/local/bin` install path was redirected to a writable dir). Result:

- Simple accessor test — PASS
- Complex nested accessor test — PASS
- **PASS: All code generation tests passed** (exit 0)

The generated `Ref` getters confirm `-> &Address` / `-> &Company`.
